answer: A sybil farmer's clones fail together -- one operator, one script, one fate. Enroll every earning identity in a mutual whose premium is priced by measured behavioral covariance: clones mirror each other's timing, counterparties and mistakes across the glacier of network traffic. High covariance means a high premium, deducted from emissions first, so a correlated farm earns like a single agent carrying a beacon. Honest agents move independently and pay almost nothing; dodging the tax means faking true independence -- the very labor the attack was meant to avoid.
